主要内容: The U.S. Department of the Treasury’s Federal Insurance Office (FIO) released its second Annual Report on the Insurance Industry on September 24, 2014. The report highlights the increasing resilience of the insurance industry in 2013, with strong financial performance and expanded growth. It also discusses the global nature of the insurance market and the importance of the U.S. domestic market. The report includes an overview of the insurance industry, analysis of financial performance, capital markets activity, and the role of non-U.S. reinsurers. It also addresses consumer protection and access to insurance, including affordability of personal auto insurance and force-placed insurance for homeowners. The report covers regulatory developments at the state, federal, and international levels. FIO, established under the Dodd-Frank Act, monitors the insurance sector for systemic risk and advises on major domestic insurance policy issues.

股票实体.名称: U.S. Department of the Treasury’s Federal Insurance Office (FIO)
